name: a_market_voices
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Named investor & analyst calls.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Stock picks and pans by named investors and TV/podcast analysts (CNBC Halftime, Fast Money, Squawk Box, Bloomberg TV — e.g. Josh Brown, Gene Munster, Dan Ives, Cathie Wood, Michael Burry positions) with the tickers named; research-firm baskets and theses (Citrini, Hunterbrook, short-seller reports) with tickers.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **PLTR** `[Software & SaaS]`
- Josh Brown identified Palantir as his “AI roller coaster stock”; the article cited a technical reference level of **$166**, corresponding to both September lows. (CNBC, Oct 15 11:39 ET)[1]

## **NVDA / AMD / DELL** `[AI Compute]`
- Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives said the October 15 AI-stock sell-off reflected financing concerns as U.S. Treasury yields moved above **5%**, while identifying canceled contracts, reduced hyperscaler capital-expenditure plans, or falling GPU rental prices as demand-warning signals. (CNBC, Oct 15; publish time not shown)[4]

## **TXRH** `[Retail]`
- Stephens upgraded Texas Roadhouse to **Overweight** from **Equal Weight** and kept its price target at **$205**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **BAC** `[Financials]`
- Baird upgraded Bank of America to **Outperform** from **Neutral** with an unchanged **$62** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **BWA** `[Automotive]`
- Bank of America upgraded BorgWarner to **Buy** from **Neutral** and raised its price target to **$85** from **$78**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **KMX** `[Retail]`
- Bank of America upgraded CarMax to **Buy** from **Underperform** and raised its price target to **$65** from **$50**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **CROX** `[Retail]`
- Barclays upgraded Crocs to **Overweight** from **Equal Weight** and raised its price target to **$139** from **$118**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **PYPL** `[Internet & Platforms]`
- Bank of America downgraded PayPal to **Underperform** from **Neutral** with a **$53** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **SPOT** `[Internet & Platforms]`
- StoneX downgraded Spotify to **Hold** from **Buy** and removed its previous price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **ACI** `[Retail]`
- JPMorgan downgraded Albertsons to **Neutral** from **Overweight** with an unchanged **$14** price target; Goldman Sachs separately downgraded it to **Neutral** from **Buy** and cut its target to **$13** from **$16**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **CRUS** `[Analog & Mixed-Signal]`
- KeyBanc downgraded Cirrus Logic to **Sector Weight** from **Overweight** without a price target, citing Apple supplier reductions and an estimate that **80%** of Cirrus Logic revenue is tied to Apple. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **PARR** `[Energy]`
- Goldman Sachs downgraded Par Pacific to **Neutral** from **Buy** and raised its price target to **$94** from **$90**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **GPN / FIS / TOST** `[Financial Technology]`
- Bank of America reinstated coverage of Global Payments with a **Buy** rating and a **$114** price target, and reinstated coverage of FIS and Toast with **Buy** ratings. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **FOUR** `[Financial Technology]`
- Bank of America reinstated coverage of Shift4 Payments with a **Neutral** rating and a **$42** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **JKHY** `[Financial Technology]`
- Bank of America reinstated coverage of Jack Henry with a **Neutral** rating and a **$165** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **FISV** `[Financial Technology]`
- Bank of America reinstated coverage of Fiserv with an **Underperform** rating and a **$48** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **WMG** `[Internet & Platforms]`
- StoneX initiated coverage of Warner Music with a **Buy** rating and a **$41** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **ON** `[Semiconductors]`
- StoneX initiated coverage of Onsemi with a **Buy** rating and a **$110** price target. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 15 06:39 ET)[10]

## **ALB / BKR / EXE / AMZN / GOOGL / HSY** `[Macro / Commodities / Energy / Internet & Platforms / Retail]`
- Morningstar listed Albemarle as its lithium-sector pick and identified Baker Hughes, Expand Energy, Amazon, Alphabet, and Hershey among additional sector picks discussed on October 15. (Morningstar, Oct 15; publish time not shown)[9]
